author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text: Do we actually need very long run AI agents? I mean AI agents that runs 24x7 non stop for weeks or months. I found the optimal flow in term of tokens usage lately is have a Sonnet running the loop with Haiku doing the mechanical tool calls. Pause it once a day, let Fable review the progress with Opus beef up the guard rail of the loop with my human guidance, then kick it off again. For GPT, Luna-max can do the loop pretty well, Astra for code review and Sol to update the harness.
